false_positive_decomposition.scope: Weighted false-positive contributions, not additive F1 attribution or independent generalization evidence.

limitations: Previously examined references are development-exposed; this is mechanistic diagnosis, not confirmation.
Per-family weighted count changes are additive; F1 is nonlinear and has no claimed additive family attribution.
Do not introduce reference-family-specific inference rules or selectively exclude declining families.
This retrospective diagnostic explains the observed precision/recall tradeoff, not whether the initial prefilter, clustering, profile expansion, or phylogeny caused it.
Broader candidate families are allowed to contain nonorthologs; final reference errors must not be conflated with candidate-stage membership.
Await the matched QfO and Three Kingdoms cap400 trials and canonical/min1 sensitivity trial before selecting an interaction or promoting defaults.
